WITH customer_clean AS (
    -- Deduplication & time-gap calculation using window functions
    SELECT 
        user_id,
        session_id,
        event_time,
        event_type,
        amount,
        COALESCE(channel, 'DIRECT') AS acquisition_channel,
        LAG(event_time, 1) OVER (
            PARTITION BY user_id 
            ORDER BY event_time ASC
        ) AS prev_event_time,
        LEAD(event_type, 1) OVER (
            PARTITION BY user_id, session_id 
            ORDER BY event_time ASC
        ) AS next_event_type,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY user_id, session_id, event_time, event_type 
            ORDER BY amount DESC NULLS LAST
        ) AS dedup_rank
    FROM raw_events
    WHERE event_time >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01 00:00:00'
      AND user_id IS NOT NULL
),
session_attribution AS (
    -- Session boundary identification and non-equi interval joins
    SELECT 
        cc.user_id,
        cc.session_id,
        cc.event_time,
        cc.event_type,
        cc.amount,
        cc.acquisition_channel,
        camp.campaign_id,
        camp.campaign_type,
        CASE 
            WHEN cc.prev_event_time IS NULL 
                 OR cc.event_time > cc.prev_event_time + INTERVAL '30' MINUTE 
            THEN 1 
            ELSE 0 
        END AS is_new_session_flag
    FROM customer_clean cc
    LEFT JOIN marketing_campaigns camp
        ON cc.acquisition_channel = camp.channel_code
       AND cc.event_time >= camp.start_time
       AND cc.event_time < camp.end_time + INTERVAL '7' DAY
    WHERE cc.dedup_rank = 1
),
running_metrics AS (
    -- Multi-frame cumulative aggregates and moving averages
    SELECT 
        user_id,
        session_id,
        event_time,
        event_type,
        amount,
        campaign_id,
        SUM(is_new_session_flag) OVER (
            PARTITION BY user_id 
            ORDER BY event_time ASC 
            ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
        ) AS calculated_session_id,
        SUM(amount) OVER (
            PARTITION BY user_id 
            ORDER BY event_time ASC 
            ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
        ) AS lifetime_spend,
        AVG(amount) OVER (
            PARTITION BY user_id 
            ORDER BY event_time ASC 
            ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING
        ) AS moving_avg_3_prior_tx,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (
            PARTITION BY user_id 
            ORDER BY amount DESC NULLS LAST
        ) AS spend_rank
    FROM session_attribution
),
user_cohorts AS (
    -- Pivot-style conditional aggregation with mathematical transforms
    SELECT 
        user_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT calculated_session_id) AS total_sessions,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN event_type = 'PURCHASE' THEN 1 END) AS total_purchases,
        SUM(CASE WHEN event_type = 'PURCHASE' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_revenue,
        MAX(event_time) AS last_active_time,
        ROUND(
            SUM(CASE WHEN event_type = 'PURCHASE' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) / 
            NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN event_type = 'PURCHASE' THEN 1 END), 0), 
            2
        ) AS avg_order_value,
        COLLECT_LIST(DISTINCT campaign_id) AS touched_campaigns
    FROM running_metrics
    GROUP BY user_id
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT calculated_session_id) >= 2
)
-- Final aggregation using subquery anti-join, grouping sets, and ranking
SELECT 
    COALESCE(rm.campaign_id, 'ORGANIC') AS resolved_campaign_id,
    DATE_TRUNC('month', rm.event_time) AS activity_month,
    rm.event_type,
    COUNT(DISTINCT rm.user_id) AS unique_active_users,
    SUM(rm.amount) AS total_gross_amount,
    PERCENT_RANK() OVER (
        PARTITION BY DATE_TRUNC('month', rm.event_time) 
        ORDER BY SUM(rm.amount) DESC
    ) AS monthly_revenue_percentile
FROM running_metrics rm
INNER JOIN user_cohorts uc 
    ON rm.user_id = uc.user_id
WHERE rm.spend_rank <= 10
  AND NOT EXISTS (
      -- Anti-join test via correlated subquery
      SELECT 1 
      FROM fraud_blacklist fb 
      WHERE fb.user_id = rm.user_id 
        AND fb.flagged_date <= rm.event_time
  )
GROUP BY GROUPING SETS (
    (DATE_TRUNC('month', rm.event_time), COALESCE(rm.campaign_id, 'ORGANIC'), rm.event_type),
    (DATE_TRUNC('month', rm.event_time), COALESCE(rm.campaign_id, 'ORGANIC')),
    (DATE_TRUNC('month', rm.event_time))
)
ORDER BY activity_month DESC, total_gross_amount DESC NULLS LAST;

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("user_id").orderBy("event_time")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("user_id").orderBy("amount DESC NULLS LAST")
w3 = Window.partitionBy("user_id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w4 = Window.partitionBy("user_id").rowsBetween(3, 1)
w5 = Window.partitionBy("user_id").orderBy("amount DESC NULLS LAST")
w6 = Window.partitionBy(DATE_TRUNC("month", "event_time")).orderBy(F.col("total_gross_amount").desc())
w7 = Window.partitionBy(DATE_TRUNC("month", "event_time")).orderBy("total_gross_amount")

result = (
    df_raw_events
    .filter((F.col("event_time") >= "2025-01-01 00:00:00") & F.col("user_id").isNotNull())
    .select(
        "user_id",
        "session_id",
        "event_time",
        "event_type",
        "amount",
        F.coalesce("channel", F.lit("DIRECT")).alias("acquisition_channel"),
        F.lag("event_time", 1).over(w).alias("prev_event_time"),
        F.lead("event_type", 1).over(w.partitionBy("user_id", "session_id")).alias("next_event_type"),
        F.row_number().over(w2).alias("dedup_rank"),
    )
    .join(df_marketing_campaigns.alias("camp"), (F.col("acquisition_channel") == F.col("camp.channel_code")) & (F.col("event_time") >= F.col("camp.start_time")) & (F.col("event_time") < (F.col("camp.end_time") + F.interval("7", "day")), "left")
    .filter(F.col("dedup_rank") == 1)
    .select(
        "user_id",
        "session_id",
        "event_time",
        "event_type",
        "amount",
        "acquisition_channel",
        F.col("camp.campaign_id").alias("campaign_id"),
        F.col("camp.campaign_type").alias("campaign_type"),
        F.when(F.col("prev_event_time").isNull() | (F.col("event_time") > (F.col("prev_event_time") + F.interval("30", "minute"))), 1).otherwise(0).alias("is_new_session_flag"),
    )
    .withColumn("calculated_session_id", F.sum("is_new_session_flag").over(w3))
    .withColumn("lifetime_spend", F.sum("amount").over(w3))
    .withColumn("moving_avg_3_prior_tx", F.avg("amount").over(w4))
    .withColumn("spend_rank", F.dense_rank().over(w5))
    .groupBy("user_id")
    .agg(
        F.countDistinct("calculated_session_id").alias("total_sessions"),
        F.count(F.when(F.col("event_type") == "PURCHASE", 1)).alias("total_purchases"),
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("event_type") == "PURCHASE", F.col("amount")).otherwise(0)).alias("total_revenue"),
        F.max("event_time").alias("last_active_time"),
        F.round((F.col("total_revenue") / NULLIF(F.count(F.when(F.col("event_type") == "PURCHASE", 1)), 0)), 2).alias("avg_order_value"),
        F.collect_list(F.col("campaign_id")).alias("touched_campaigns"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("total_sessions") >= 2)
    .withColumn("resolved_campaign_id", F.coalesce("campaign_id", F.lit("ORGANIC")))
    .withColumn("activity_month", F.date_trunc("month", "event_time"))
    .withColumn("event_type", "event_type")
    .withColumn("unique_active_users", F.countDistinct("user_id"))
    .withColumn("total_gross_amount", F.sum("amount"))
    .withColumn("monthly_revenue_percentile", F.percent_rank().over(w6))
    .join(df_fraud_blacklist.alias("fb"), (F.col("user_id") == F.col("fb.user_id")) & (F.col("fb.flagged_date") <= F.col("event_time")), "left")
    .filter(~F.col("fb.user_id").isNotNull() | F.lit(exists = False))
    .groupBy(F.groupingSets(
        (F.date_trunc("month", "event_time"), F.col("resolved_campaign_id"), F.col("event_type")),
        (F.date_trunc("month", "event_time"), F.col("resolved_campaign_id")),
        (F.date_trunc("month", "event_time")),
    ))
    .agg(
        F.countDistinct("user_id").alias("unique_active_users"),
        F.sum("total_gross_amount").alias("total_gross_amount"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("activity_month").desc(), F.col("total_gross_amount").descNullsLast())
)
